author: Bellular News
description:
XBOX just brought back console exclusives — Gears of War: E-Day and Clockwork Revolution are never coming to PlayStation — and new CEO Asha Sharma says Microsoft's 30% margin mandate is gone. After 100 days of price cuts, shipped features and fan service, the comeback looks real. But Sharma keeps repeating one phrase: "resetting the business". That's the part worth paying attention to.
